title: For every n at least three, the explicit corner monomial map intertwines all Kashiwara operators on horizontal regular partitions for affine sl(n), including odd n
author: Peter Tingley
source_version: Official SIGMA 6 (2010) article 035, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2010.035; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

source_locator.theorem: Theorem5.1 explicit horizontal-partition to monomial intertwiner
source_locator.label: iso-th

difficulty_reason: The boundary monomial product does not automatically preserve the operator selecting a surviving bracket in a partition signature. The proof translates the forbidden horizontal hook condition into precise height and content inequalities for addable and removable boxes, then proves that the monomial and partition signatures differ only by canceling adjacent pairs. A separate local corner update identifies the resulting monomial factor for each selected box, completing the explicit intertwining for even and odd n.

source_check.note: The complete original Theorem5.1 is retained for n>=3, the horizontal arm sequence and partitions with no corresponding illegal hooks. All new height and content ordering, local update of addable and removable corners, forbidden hook inequalities and exact surviving bracket correspondence are bundled. The established Nakajima and Fayers crystal constructions are retained in their cited formulations; no new proof of those named prerequisites is attempted. Original Russian partition and coordinate figures remain diagram assets. Neither a higher-level extension nor the separate immediate crystal-component corollary is selected. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: Read complete definitions and both operator rules2-4, horizontal arm sequence A_t=ceil(nt/2)-1 and order Lemma4.4 on5, full corner update Lemma5.2 on5-6, forbidden-hook/height-order Lemma5.3 on6-7 with Figure4, and full signature-cancellation proof Theorem5.1 on7. Select the explicit map Psi from all addable/removable corners restricted to horizontally regular partitions B^H, for every n>=3 and every residue mod n, preserving both e and f, with Psi(0)=0. Fayers partition crystal Theorem4.1 is a precisely stated prior foundation. Nakajima even-n Theorem3.4 is background only: the authored signature proof itself handles odd n and does not cite a nonexistent odd-n monomial theorem. No arbitrary monomial component or higher-level extension; Corollary5.4 is a same-core consequence and not a second count. Exact selected statement and terminal proof pages rendered and visually inspected; physical headers/native ZIP members and source/license hashes checked. No independent mathematical reproof.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem5.1 for n>=3, horizontal arm sequence A_t=ceil(nt/2)-1 and partitions with no corresponding illegal hook. The explicit boundary monomial product intertwines both authored partition and monomial Kashiwara operators for every color residue, including odd n. Psi(0)=0; no whole-monomial-space crystal assertion or higher-level extension.
